purpose: Fresh seed43 repeat of the 7B learning-rate 5e-5 setting selected by final seed42 validation64 macro PQ, with macro recall as tie-breaker. Final checkpoint after 1,000 optimizer steps evaluated on the same validation cohort.
reward: R_fmt + binary foreground IoU against full instance masks; no count, separation or topology reward.

optimizer_evidence.adapter_changed_steps_definition: Count of steps whose adapter differs from its initial weights; not a comparison against the preceding step.

resources.training_elapsed_definition: Training-loop elapsed, including periodic evaluations and checkpoint work; not the sum of optimizer-step durations.

data.selection: Official-30 MoNuSeg training sources, patient-disjoint train/validation partition; selected native 128x128 crops with 1-8 annotated nuclei. This run evaluates all 64 validation crops; benchmark8 is not pooled into a separate metric.
data.gt_count_unit: Crop-level GT instances/occurrences. A source nucleus crossing a crop border can occur in more than one crop; all such occurrences remain within one patient/split. Existing crop metrics retain total_gt_count=384, not 340.

example_selection_rule: Lexicographically first ID with GT count exactly 1 and first with GT count >1; no output-based selection

evidence.raw_answers: before_records.jsonl and after_records.jsonl preserve all source completion records byte-for-byte.

conclusion: The final seed43 checkpoint raised macro PQ from 0.0226549 to 0.0455516 and matched GT occurrences from 9 to 11 of 384. Count MAE worsened slightly. Compared with selected seed42, final macro PQ is higher but TP is lower (11 versus 12) and count MAE is worse. This is a repeat of a validation-selected setting on reused validation, not an independent test or a two-seed comparison of both learning rates.
limitations: The setting was selected using seed42 final validation64 macro PQ, with macro recall as tie-breaker, and then repeated on the same cohort. Selection and evaluation data are not independent.
Only the selected 5e-5 setting was repeated; this is not a two-seed comparison of both learning rates.
The final 1,000-step checkpoint is reported, not the best intermediate checkpoint. Nine periodic evaluations occurred during training.
The 384 crop-level GT occurrences correspond to 340 unique source nuclei; border fragments stay within the same patient/split. Crop recall retains denominator 384.
Only 11 of 384 crop-level GT occurrences match. Four validation patients and two seeds for a selected setting do not establish reliable performance or generalization.
No pooling with benchmark8. Full-mask reward engineering; no weak-label, SOTA or clinical claim.
invalid_answer_handling: Two of 64 before answers are rejected as whole responses; all 64 after answers are valid. Empty final masks for rejected answers remain in every metric denominator; exact emitted text is retained.

saved_decision.criterion: Final validation64 macro PQ, then macro recall; ties choose baseline LR

seed_repeat_comparison.interpretation: Only seed and output path differ in saved arguments. The initial adapter weights differ, while initial greedy completions and mask artifacts are identical. Final scores remain reused-validation observations after setting selection, not independent test evidence.

output_count_diagnostic.interpretation: After training, 63 of 64 valid answers contain exactly one object; the remaining answer contains two. The validation cohort has only one single-nucleus crop. Multi-object localization therefore remains unresolved despite higher foreground reward and fully valid output formatting.
